findings.documented: The API key is appended as an api_key query parameter.
findings.actual: The service rejects query-string keys and requires the X-API-Key header.
findings.how_found: Called /v1/listings with api_key, then followed the explicit 401 response.

findings.documented: Login returns token and there is no refresh flow.
findings.actual: Successful login returns access_token, refresh_token and refresh_url, not token.
findings.how_found: Logged in with the issued demo account and inspected response field names without recording token values.
findings.impact: A frontend following the documented response cannot create a bearer session.

findings.documented: Collections use one-indexed page and return total, page and page_size.
findings.actual: The retrievable collection uses offset, limit, returned and has_more; paging with those server-reported values reaches 5,100 records.
findings.how_found: Retrieved the complete collection in 200-record batches, advancing offset by returned until has_more was false.
findings.impact: Page-based clients may repeat, skip or stop before the final records.

findings.documented: Returns active sale listings only; inactive, expired and withdrawn records are excluded.
findings.actual: The unfiltered collection contains 5,100 records, of which 1,083 have is_live false.
findings.how_found: Downloaded every response page and counted the is_live flag locally.
findings.impact: A client must exclude inactive records itself before presenting homes for sale.

findings.documented: Every listing corresponds to exactly one physical property.
findings.actual: 100 duplicate records share an identical latitude, longitude and bedroom count with another listing, yielding 5,000 distinct properties across 5,100 records.
findings.how_found: Grouped the complete collection by latitude, longitude and bedroom count, then inspected repeated property records.
findings.impact: Naive listing counts overstate available properties.

findings.documented: Listing records are safe to show to users.
findings.actual: 33 records contain impossible values: a non-positive sale price, carpet area larger than super built-up area, or a floor above total_floors.
findings.how_found: Validated price, area and floor invariants across every listing record.
findings.impact: These records produce impossible prices, areas or building details in the UI and must be excluded.

findings.documented: Listings returned by the collection are safe to show to a user.
findings.actual: Eleven sale records carry implausible 17,470–44,440 prices despite normal-sized homes; they are probable enquiry-generation listings rather than genuine sale offers.
findings.how_found: Compared all sale prices against the full-city price distribution and checked these records' bedroom and carpet-area fields.
findings.impact: They severely distort price sorting and price-per-square-foot calculations, and can mislead home seekers.

findings.documented: price_min and price_max are integer Indian rupees.
findings.actual: Project prices are decimal crores: P50016 price_max 12.44 represents ₹124,400,000, not ₹12.44.
findings.how_found: Compared project decimals against listing sale-price magnitudes and validated the highest project price.
findings.impact: Displaying the documented unit makes every project price wrong by a factor of 10,000,000.

findings.documented: total_listings is recomputed and always agrees with listings in the project.
findings.actual: 446 projects' reported total_listings differs from the number of retrievable listing records with that project_id.
findings.how_found: Counted complete listings by project_id and compared each count against the complete projects collection.
findings.impact: Project inventory badges cannot rely on total_listings.

findings.documented: Pre-computed city aggregates are available at this route.
findings.actual: GET /v1/analytics/summary returned 404 Not Found when called with the issued API key header.
findings.how_found: Called the documented route while verifying available endpoints.
findings.impact: The documented analytics integration cannot call this endpoint; the app calculates transparent aggregates from listings instead.
